skills.name: Feedback
skills.text: When a player damages Sima Yi, he can choose to take one of their cards and place it in his hand.

skills.name: Devil
skills.text: After a judgment card is flipped, Sima Yi can discard one of his hand cards. The hand card that Sima Yi discard then becomes the new judgment card.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
